The controller records data_0209f49c (bss) are read only by func_0200bb28 and func_02009e70. the D1/D0 pair and its helpers at 0x0200705c..0x020072c4 are their own TU (src/engine/view/d_camera_dtor.cpp).
Pragmas: none added. #4479 showed opt_common_subs off inert for func_0200bb28, which matches under the file's defaults.

func_020072c4 (0x020072c4..0x020073a0) folded in as the low edge. Its only reference is the script-op member-function constant data_02086ca8 in this TU's .data, between the constants for func_020071e0 and func_020073a0. Below it, _ZN7Vector3D1Ev at 0x020072c0 ends the d_camera_dtor.cpp object, so no other TU can sit between. Defined last in source; deferred codegen emits it first.

notes: Fold of dCamera_c: 16 named members plus 37 camera state handlers/dispatchers recovered as unmangled func_* symbols. mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order, so the file runs ROM-descending from classInit. The recovered bodies were C; each sits under `#pragma cplusplus off` (the pinned -lang c++ build parses those regions as C89, so block-top declarations only) keeping the unmangled symbol names.

Leftovers: the C bodies keep raw-offset member access ((char*)self + 0xNNN) where the real field names are not yet recovered, and the camera state records are TU-local opaque typedefs (CamEntryE, CamFixedTab, CamViewObj, CamStateBase, CamStateIdx, CamJitter, the dBgCh_* shadows). POD `Vec3` shadows replace Vector3 inside the C regions because Vector3's empty destructor makes it non-POD and inflates the stack frame by 8 bytes (measured on func_0200c394).

The 88 functions below 0x0200bec4 were one-function shards (66 C, 20 C++); they now use dCamera_c/dActor_c/daPly_c member names in C++ under extern "C" (no cplusplus-off regions), share the file's CamMode/CamViewObj/Entry3 records, and keep their ROM names.

Static initializer folded: the nineteen dCamera_c::State records (two CamPmf each) are defined in this TU. mwcc emits __sinit_d_camera.cpp, byte- and relocation-identical to retail __sinit_02073a24, plus the .ctor word at 0x02086b60 and the .bss span 0x0209b008..0x0209b138. The .data PMF constants stay unowned. No destructor-registration nodes and no @ temps.

compiler_only_output.reason: Native Vector3 collision-return locals cause the front end to emit the empty vague-linkage destructor (4 bytes, bx lr). All call sites are elided; the retail cartridge keeps its identical canonical body at arm9:0x020072c0. Production isolation verifies the duplicate against that ROM body before discarding it.
